description:
Create a Time Tracker project on a property, together with its first budget (seeded with a default service so time can be logged right away). Managers only. type is internal, client or retainer; currency is a 3-letter code; periodStart is YYYY-MM-DD. Add more budgets with create_time_tracker_budget and services with create_time_tracker_service. Only @seoalive.com accounts can use the time tracking tools.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// create a retainer project with its first monthly budget.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","name":"Acme SEO","type":"retainer","budgetName":"November 2026","currency":"EUR","periodStart":"2026-11-01"}
```
name: create_time_tracker_project

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

title: Create time tracker project
